opening.text: Okay... suit's holding. Good. Wait, is that a light? ... Yeah. Over there.

lights.text: Oh, wow! A gym? All the way out here?

robot.text: Oh! A visitor. Hang on... let me get down.

greeting.text: Hey, I'm Orbit. So... how about a quick look around?

guide.text: All right. What do you feel like working on? Pick a station. I'll come with you.

tour-review.text: Got a workout clip? Bring it over. I'll point out what I can see. And if the angle's tricky... I'll say so. No guessing.

tour-missions.text: Take your time with the feedback. When you're done, finish the review and step back outside the station. That's when your activity gets logged.

tour-energy.text: Your workouts keep this place running. Well... that's the story. Five activity days earn twenty energy credits. Have a look in Missions for the details.

tour-settings.text: Music too much? Camera a bit quick? Settings is right up there. Your journal keeps this visit's clips and notes. They're yours. Delete them whenever you like.

tour-play.text: Oh, and those consoles? Break time. Try the lights, the memory board, or the orbit dial. I won't count it as a workout... but I won't judge, either.

analysis-start.text: Okay, got it. Give me a moment to look through this.

analysis-ready.text: All right, there's a few moments to look at. Tap a time. We'll go through it together.

analysis-partial.text: Hmm... I can see parts of it. Let's start there. I've left you a few tips for getting the rest in view.

analysis-insufficient.text: Ah, I can't quite see enough here. That's okay. Check the recording tips, and we'll give it another go.

first-review.text: Hey, first one done! Nice. Your notes are in the journal. Come back to them whenever you're ready.
